comparisons.name: network-bar-dark
comparisons.description: The Network pane's bar drawn with the group's network variant, Dark Aqua: add, remove, the action button and the filler cell. The gear and its chevron are masked: they are the library's own drawing. What is scored is the bar: its lighter fill and its three line colours.

comparisons.name: network-bar-light
comparisons.description: The Network pane's bar drawn with the group's network variant, Aqua, with the gear and its chevron masked.

comparisons.name: action-bar-light
comparisons.description: Add, remove and the action button under the services list of the Network pane, with the filler cell, Aqua. The gear and its chevron are masked: they are the library's own drawing. What is scored is the bar: the 28 pt action cell, the borders and the fills.

comparisons.name: action-bar-light-artwork
comparisons.description: As action-bar-light with nothing masked, Aqua: the gear and its chevron are substitute artwork, drawn on the measured ink box, and this scores that drawing against Apple's.

comparisons.name: pull-down-light
comparisons.description: An action button that is the trigger of a Base UI menu, after a real click has opened the menu, Aqua: it is drawn as pressed while the menu is open.

pixels.note: pressed fill (spec: gradient-button, States, pressed, inferred); that an open pull-down is drawn as pressed is this library's reading of AppKit, not shown in any screenshot
the add button beside it keeps the resting fill (spec: Fill, measured)
